title: Client Discovery Harness - Research Finding
description: Evidence interpreted through a Master Note lens. The atom of this harness: a finding is traceable both back to its source document and back to the framework question that produced it.

evidence_type.description: FACT names one source passage. INFERENCE names the findings it was reasoned from and no source of its own. ASSUMPTION and MISSING_EVIDENCE name nothing and say so. Enforced by core/evidence.py, not expressible here.

mn_basis.description: Framework ids this reading came from, e.g. ["MN02"].

lang.description: Language of the free-text fields in this record.

supporting_finding_ids.description: INFERENCE only: the findings it was reasoned from. Empty for every other type. An inference points at findings rather than at a source, because copying a source_id onto it would present a conclusion as something a document said.
